evals.prompt: Build a self-contained HTML file with a scatterplot of 10,000 random points across 5 categories. Use hover to identify points and a 2D brush to select them. Show a count of selected points. The file must work when opened directly in a browser (use CDN imports).

Build a self-contained HTML file with a Canvas bar chart (15 bars) that supports keyboard navigation with arrow keys, announces the focused bar to screen readers, and has a fallback data table toggle. The file must work when opened directly in a browser (use CDN imports).

Build a self-contained HTML file with a 3-panel dashboard: a scatterplot, a histogram, and a data table. Brushing the scatter should filter the histogram and table. Use 300 synthetic data points with 4 categories. The file must work when opened directly in a browser (use CDN imports).

Build a self-contained HTML file that shows a small hierarchy (3 levels, ~20 nodes) as a treemap. Add a button that smoothly transitions to a sunburst layout. Use d3.hierarchy, d3.treemap, d3.partition, and d3.arc. Keep it simple — no extra features. The file must work when opened directly in a browser (use CDN imports).

Build a self-contained HTML file with a time series chart showing 2 years of daily data. Include an overview panel at the bottom with a brush that controls the time range of the detail panel above it. Show proper time-formatted axes. The file must work when opened directly in a browser (use CDN imports).
